This task is a reminder to clean those up new gazebo is up and running." The reporter documents no failed interaction; the agreed scope is "grep for `gazebo_ros_pkgs` and `turtlebot3_gazebo` and make sure they are removed or replaced by their superseding package. nothing else." (https://github.com/ros-navigation/navigation2/issues/4386#issuecomment-2142938314). The only error log is a commenter's attempt to run the rolling simulation in docker (`PackageNotFoundError: "package 'turtlebot3_gazebo' not found, ..."`, https://github.com/ros-navigation/navigation2/issues/4386#issuecomment-2146211447), which the maintainer answers as a known state, not a defect: "The system tests in rolling are commented out since we do not have a working simulation in new-gazebo yet." (https://github.com/ros-navigation/navigation2/issues/4386#issuecomment-2146350704). The linked PR #3634 ("Initial support to the new Gazebo", addressing navigation2#2997) adds new-Gazebo launch files, worlds, a bridge configuration and package dependencies; it is a feature migration, not a fix of a documented defect.
